name: unset_bookmark
description: Remove the bookmark at a mapped hexadecimal address and return whether it is absent. Hopper also permits removing an existing legacy bookmark outside mapped memory. This mutates navigation metadata and does not alter binary bytes.

__schema0.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

__schema1.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets
